reviews.text: We had a brilliant experience at Pawfection! Kevin gave us the knowledge, skills and confidence we needed to raise our puppy and was always happy to answer any extra questions we had. He was so helpful, approachable and knowledgeable. I’d highly recommend Kevin to anyone starting their puppy journey! 🐾

Kevin has helped me countless times , I’m currently fostering dogs and they change from time to time . No matter the personality or breed (I have large dogs) Kevin is always willing to help .

I love the style used as well , Kevin recognises behaviours and caters to your dog specifically. All methods used are without force or stern words which I really appreciate.

You can honestly see the kindness and attention to detail . I’ve recommended him countless times and I’ll continue to do so as the classes actually work 🙌

Thank you Kevin . We will see you soon

We contacted Kevin about our dog Loki who was having problems socialising with other dogs and was reactive to dogs and anyone passing on walks, we had tried several times unsuccessfully to sort the problem and weren't optimistic that Kevin would be able to help. From the first meeting we found Kevin a tremendous help and the tips and techniques he gave us began to work immediately. With a lot of work and seeing the progress with Loki it gave us the confidence to take him to parks and the beach where we would have been afraid to bring him before, we would highly recommend Kevin and are with the way the training went for us

I started Kevin's classes as I had recently rescued a lurcher who was very nervous around other dogs. I wanted help with socialising her along with teaching her recall. Within two classes she had lost her fear and was having a great time meeting other dogs! Kevin helped me with my own confidence too which was key to my training skills! I would absolutely recommend Kevin, he is extremely helpful and is a very calm influence! Thank you Kevin

Me and my dog Butter had a lovely time with Kevin. My Butter gets very excited on walks and gets reactive and so it has become really frustrating and embarrassing to walk him. With Kevin’s guidance & patience, I have gained confidence in walking Butter. Butter has become more calm as well and it’s all thanks to Kevin. Would highly recommend his one to one training. I am hoping to get puppy classes soon with Kevin too 🙏🏼

Kevin wa sabsoultely an angel in disguise for Cooper my 6 year old lab - after making the move from India to ireland - it was hard for me to meet the expectations of a new place with my overly anxious dog - but Kevin’s little tips and tricks makes my walks so much smoother and I’m so much more confident with Cooper - HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

Kevin was so helpful with our rescue dog , she was reacting to a new dog in the house after moving back from London and he gave us so many useful tips on how to integrate them properly & how to react less on walks

We had a great experience with Pawfection Dog Training. Kevin was brilliant with our boxer Lily. We were really struggling with her jumping up, biting the lead on walks and getting very over excited.

Kevin gave us simple advice that actually worked. Once we started putting his tips into practice we saw a big difference. Lily is much calmer now, she’s stopped biting the lead and the jumping has improved massively.

He explains things in a way that makes sense and doesn’t overcomplicate it. You can tell he really understands dogs.

Would 100% recommend. Thanks again Kevin!
Simple and easy to repeat training hints and exercises for us to continue working on. An almost immediate improvement in her behaviour! Highly recommend Kevin 👏🏻 …

Kevin was brilliant in helping us with our 8-month-old GSD x Golden Retriever, who had been barking at people when they came into our home. He developed a clear, practical routine for answering the door that quickly improved this behaviour.
What really stood out were Kevin’s follow-up check-ins after the session, which showed how committed he is to supporting his clients. I would highly recommend Kevin to anyone who is concerned about or unsure of their puppy’s behavioural development.
Great for dogs

We had Kevin come out to do a one on one session with our 2 year old family dog who was having trouble with excessive barking especially out the back garden! Struggling with people coming into the house and also demand barking. Kevin was brilliant and really gave us good insight and tips to what to do. We noticed a difference in Zola after a couple of days due to consistency in the exercises and training Kevin gave us to do.
Other people have commented on Zolas behaviour and how she is so different and well behaved. We couldn't recommend Kevin enough and are so thankful for his help bringing some normality back into our lives with Zola!

Brought a new golden retriever puppy to the course and had a whale of a time. Lots of socialisation with other young dogs, lots of useful information and ongoing advice for me as a new owner, and lots of patience too. A great way to spend a Sunday afternoon, and would completely recommend as a starter course for new dog owners. I took a punt on the group courses when some providers are charging an arm and a leg for individual sessions and visits, but I can't imagine getting more out of them than I did with Kevin and the time spent at his sessions.

Had an absolutely fantastic experience with Kevin. Our puppy had the best time in his classes and had really positive socialisation experiences.
Kevin was brilliant with her and so willing to work/give advice on anything that came up during the weeks. The classes really boosted our confidence with what we had got right and helped us address anything we were unsure on like how to get pup to not pick up things up when we're out walking.
I would highly recommend his classes to anyone how wants help with their dogs behaviour or wants  safe structured socialisation for puppies with great tips and tricks along the way!
Thank you Aishling :)
Thank you Connor :)
Great experience, Kevin was brilliant with our puppy 😊 definitely recommend …

We took our four year old rescue dog Cassie to Kevin’s pawfect manners classes to get her more comfortable around other dogs and work on her focus. She was like a new dog by the end of the 5 weeks! Not only was she more comfortable and happy around other dogs, but we now understand her behaviours and triggers better thanks to Kevin’s help. He was very attentive and supportive between classes also. We would definitely recommend for a dog who needs help with socialising and focusing!
Amazing, profesional trainer with great approach ! Kevin gave us a lot of practical tips! Would highly recommend the classes, we all enjoyed it.

We had a 1:1 with Kevin to help us with our dogs behaviour towards visitors in the house. Kevin helped us understand where the problem was originating from, and taught us strategies to help manage his behaviour. We could see changes in his behaviour very quickly. Kevin kept in touch in the weeks afterwards to see how we were getting on and provide support. We found Kevin very knowledgable and we would highly recommend him to others.

We met Kevin in various local parks with our pup. He was so helpful with our very reactive terrier cross, who was afraid of other dogs.
She now walks happily every week between her two best labrador buddies

Kevin came down to our house a few weeks ago to help our puppy Charlie with her recall and over excitement when visitors came over. He gave us fantastic advice and training tips that are working brilliantly! He even helped with training her outside which was amazing! 10/10 recommendation Kevin is fantastic!

I recommend Pawfection, they were very flexible as our dog was booked for Puppy training, but because she is car sick we had to change to a private session. We found that Kevin has a real understanding of the individuality of dogs, their personalities and their breed types. He identified certain pieces to work on. Following his training we and our Pup have made significant progress. We’ll keep practising thanks Kevin.

II wanted to share my extremely positive experience with Kevin. He is incredibly helpful and consistently addresses any issues you might have with your dog.
Kevin provides valuable information and follows up diligently with you to monitor your training progress. He offers a tailored approach to dog training when needed and is excellent at resolving specific behavioral concerns. He truly goes the extra mile to help his clients and is a very pleasant person to work with.
I highly recommend his services!

Kevin at Pawfection has been fantastic! He completely stopped Henry’s resource guarding, which was a huge relief for us. What really stood out was how much he cared beyond the sessions he made sure to follow up and check in on Henry’s progress afterwards. The personal touch and genuine commitment made all the difference. Highly recommend!

Really enjoyed these puppy training classes. Doug is our first puppy so we really wanted to get him trained as best we could from as early as possible which we owe a huge thanks to Kevin. He gave us great help in the weekly classes and supported us during the week with any questions we had. Definitely recommend!

Couldn’t recommend Kevin enough. We attended the 5 week training session, Kevin was so supportive, calm and reassuring and his follow up was really helpful. Delighted we attended and Dougie passed with flying colours 😊 …

We have just completed a course of puppy classes with our now 5-month-old golden retriever, Daisy, and couldn't be happier with the experience. Kevin was incredibly patient and calm with both the dogs and their owners! Prior to attending the classes Kevin made a house visit to help us with crate training and some unwanted behaviours which all soon resolved under his guidance.

What stands out is how he maintained communication between classes, ensuring we had all we needed to reinforce the training at home. My kids also participated in the classes, and they loved it! They learned valuable skills and are very confident handling the dog. I highly recommend Kevin's puppy classes and we will definitely be signing up to his agility classes once our pup is old enough!

Kevin was an absolute Gent to deal with,
I have a rescued patterdale terrier who was quite the definition of stubborn and was full of anxiety.
Thanks to all of Kevin's help, this is no longer the case he is a completely different dog and it's all thanks to Kevin's patience to not only teach Buddy but also to teach me how to be patient and how to control my dog.

I couldn't recommend Kevin enough, even the checkups on buddy to see the progress and all of the advice show he cares and really wants to help,

If you need a genuine, patient and strong character to assist you with any help with your dogs behaviour or even just obedience training Pawfection Dog Training tops all.

Myself and my daughter thoroughly enjoyed our Beginners Agility Classes with Kevin.
Very friendly and a great teacher.
We can't wait to go back and continue our classes after our holidays!!
Thanks Kevin 🐶🤎🙏🏻

I came to Kevin for a one to one lesson as I was having problems with my dog Saul barking at bikes/scooters and showing excitement reactivity towards dogs. Because of this, I never brought him to parks or public spaces as I was worried about what other people would say if he acted up. After our lesson, I was feeling much more confident in what to do if a situation like this arises and I left with many tips and tricks in keeping Saul calm when one of these triggers appears.by the end of the lesson, I had already seen an improvement and we were able to walk by these triggers with no reaction.  After putting these tips into practice I now bring Saul everywhere with me and continue to see him become calmer each time I bring him out in public. Thanks Kevin!

My dad and my pup Teddy completed a training course with Kevin, they both got so much from it, Teddy no longer jumps on people when we are out walking, he will sit and lay down.  He will go to bed when told, he isn’t as hyper when he sees other dogs etc. Kevin showed us how to train Teddy and we practiced during the week between classes and Teddy now listens to us and understands instructions.  Thank you Kevin.
Highly recommend Kevin, not just for training the puppies but the humans too😂 …
Available to answer questions outside of classes. Knows dogs behaviours very well and good techniques for improving behaviours

Couldn't recommend Kevin enough😁 we completed a 5 week group class and have seen massive improvements in our dog's behaviour. Kevin is patient and keeps in contact with you between each week to stay up to date on how your dog is improving and sends on extra information on tips on how to help their be behaviour. We really enjoyed the classes and will now be able to continue progress with our dog thanks to Kevin's help and expertise😁

We had a great time at these classes and  could see an improvement right away. It was great for us as a family and for Ron. He had loads of fun eating other dogs. It good to see that what ever problems you think you have, you're not alone. And with persistence and patience your dog can change. 10/10;would recommend

Took my 6 month old terrier mix to Kevin as he was really highly strung and hard to control . Kevin was such a lovely guy and did a fantastic job in classes showing me how to work with jasper and gain more control he’s much easier to handle now and I have a much better understanding of how he’s reacting and how to handle it . Would 100% recommend
Kevin has been great and has really helped us with our big pup Baloo! Lots of great training tips, classes were really useful and also fun. Highly recommend!

We really enjoyed working with Kevin and have seen an improvement in our dogs behavior from the first few weeks. Kevin listened to what our issues were and worked with us to make changes. We appreciated the check ins between classes as it helped us with the work we did at home.
I would highly recommend Kevin. We took away some valuable pointers for our puppy from the sessions. He was helpful in teaching the kids to work with the dog.

Highly recommend Kevin, my dog has terrible separation anxiety and when we moved to an apartment she would bark constantly when left alone. Kevin came out and spent time with us, and I felt he really understood what my dog needed and how to give us the right tools and advice to help her. He remained in contact to ensure everything was progressing as planned and within a few weeks my dog’s behaviour is so much better. We can leave her alone now without worrying about the noise and she is calmer and happier as well.

I can't recommend Pawfection Dog Training  enough! In just one session, Kevin completely resolved my dogs' issues with walking, pulling the lead and barking at people, birds and dogs —problems that had been ongoing for quite some time. I brought my a Cavapoo 2 yrs old and was really difficult to bring him for walk. I decided to find a dog trainer and  Kevin’s approach was clear, effective, and easy to implement. I had previously reached out to another professional who referred me to a dog behaviorist, which didn’t feel like the right fit for my situation. Thankfully, I found Kevin, and he proved that the right trainer can make a huge difference. I'm beyond impressed with how quickly and simply he addressed the issues. Thank you so much!"

Highly recommend Kevin at Pawfection training! Helped my little daschund so much and she loved the classes! Small classes so it is easier to focus and great training tips!

Kevin was instrumental in teaching me how to train my two dogs (labradors). His knowledge and expertise shows at all levels, and can be backed up by his vast experience in animal behaviour and dog training. His simple tricks and kind and …

We are very thankful to Kevin who is great trainer!His classes are very engaging,full of super practical tips around training puppies! Kevin encouraged us to send us questions and videos of our home training ,then sent us back advice and …
We had a really positive experience at Pawfection. We really like Kevin's reward based approach to training. We regularly get complimented on our well behaved pup!

Just finished our 5 week block and can’t wait to go again . Mac and myself loved it . Such a relaxed and easy to learn environment, Kevin is excellent and I can’t believe how quickly we picked it up !!!

Highly recommend Kevin for dog training. We came to Kevin for support with our Labrador who was lead reactive, with 1-1 session and group classes we made huge strides and really enjoyed the classes. The lead reactivity has improved hugely …
